description: This Java source file defines a helper class for testing Akka persistence snapshots specifically for Things services. It provides methods to retrieve the maximum snapshot and all snapshots (ascending order) for a given ThingId, utilizing Akka’s persistence APIs.

classes.name: ThingsSnapshotTestHelper
classes.description: A helper class designed to facilitate testing with Akka persistence snapshots. It interacts with the Akka snapshot store to retrieve maximum and all snapshots for a specified ThingId, converting snapshot data into domain objects.

methods.name: ThingsSnapshotTestHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the helper with ActorSystem, snapshot conversion function, and domain ID to persistence ID mapping.

methods.name: getMaxSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves the latest snapshot for a given ThingId, if available.

methods.name: getAllSnapshotsAscending
methods.description: Retrieves all snapshots for a given ThingId in ascending order.

methods.name: convertSnapshotDataToDomainObject
methods.description: Converts SelectedSnapshot data into the domain-specific object using provided conversion function.

methods.name: getAllSnapshotDataAscending
methods.description: Collects all snapshots in ascending order from the maximum snapshot.

methods.name: getMaxSnapshotDataBySequenceNumber
methods.description: Fetches snapshot data for a specific persistence ID and sequence number range.

methods.name: getMaxSnapshotData
methods.description: Fetches the maximum snapshot data for a persistence ID.

methods.name: convertScalaOpt
methods.description: Converts a Scala Option to a Java object, with a default fallback.

methods.name: waitForFuture
methods.description: Synchronously waits for a Java Future to complete within a timeout period.
